structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a copycat "p(doom)" token. It rides an apparent Yudkowsky/"allTheYud" X post about AI doom odds. At least nine other P(DOOM) tokens launched within hours, and the leader (Aq7r…) is at about $2.7M market cap. This one was created at 10:20 UTC, well after the leader and two others that sit at $700k–$830k. It was deployed directly to PumpSwap, not through a pump.fun curve. Its metadata description links to another P(DOOM) contract (ARPw…), which suggests copied metadata. It pumped about 400% in 14 minutes to roughly $55k and has now pulled back to about $50k. The last 5 minutes show buys and sells nearly even (196 vs 193).

narrative.description: p(doom), the probability of AI catastrophe, tied to an X post by Eliezer Yudkowsky (allTheYud). This AI-doom meme has proven crypto appeal, and a live trigger post is driving a wave of tokens.
narrative.why_spreading: A famous figure posted, and the p(doom) meme is widely known in AI and crypto circles. The whole ticker is getting attention, as the leader's $2.7M market cap and more than $1M in hourly volume across several copies show.

token_connection.why_this_token: Only the shared name and ticker connect it. It was launched late in a crowded race, has no socials or website of its own, and its description points to another P(DOOM) contract.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Aq7r… ($2.7M market cap, the clear leader), Exk6… ($834k), ARPw… ($711k, the earliest large one), Bra6… ($63k, launched at nearly the same time), plus about six smaller clones.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN flags 53 bundler wallets, and bundlers are the top traders at 44% (top_bundler_trader_pct). RugCheck finds an insider trade network of 41 wallets. There are 2,100 unique buyers but only 86 unique sellers, which fits bot or bundled buy-side farming. The creator has closed out and 100% of the LP is unlocked. There are no smart-money or KOL wallets.
authenticity.uncertainty: Some of the buying could be real spillover from traders who cannot tell which P(DOOM) is the right one. The top-10 holders (20%, excluding the pool) are not extremely concentrated.

structural_risks: 100% of LP unlocked on a direct PumpSwap pool, so the creator or LP provider can pull liquidity at any time
53 bundler wallets holding about 44% of top-trader share
Late clone that the $2.7M leader will crowd out
Momentum already stalling, with buys and sells nearly even over the last 5 minutes

structured_output.counterargument: The narrative is hot and the leader is at $2.7M. Liquidity is fairly deep for the market cap (about $46k against $50k). If spillover buyers keep rotating into cheaper clones, a $50k clone could easily reach $100k+, as ARPw and Exk6 did at $700k+. Mint and freeze authority are renounced, and the creator holds nothing.
unknowns: Whether the Yudkowsky post keeps spreading or attention consolidates entirely on the leader

structured_output.thesis: This is a late, bundled clone with unlocked LP in a crowded ticker war. The leader has already won the attention, and this coin's early pump looks like bundlers farming spillover. A pull of liquidity or a bleed is more likely than a 2x.
